'''Up-worlder''' was a term indicating [[Upper City]] and [[Lower City]] dwellers used by the [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]] located in the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], Taris around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]].
